narrative.headline: 2018 Jeep Cherokee: the power train drives most owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 677 complaints with NHTSA. The power train is by far the most reported area at 43%, followed by the electrical system (28%) and engine (23%). No injuries or deaths are reported in these top areas. A handful of complaints mention fire (electrical and engine) or crashes, so check the drivetrain and electronics closely on a test drive.

issues.title: Power Train
issues.blurb: The single biggest complaint: 289 reports (43%), with 1 crash. Watch for transmission overheating, rough shifting, or warning lights while driving.

issues.title: Electrical System
issues.blurb: Second most reported: 189 reports (28%), including 2 crashes and 1 fire. Check that the electronics behave consistently and watch for unexpected gear or mode changes.
